  "barcode" text NOT NULL,
  "brand" text,
  "category" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric,
  "subcategory" text,
  "unit" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
